definition: For each identical successful input ID, comparator seconds / ConcordTree seconds. At each taxon count show the exact minimum and maximum of these individual ratios.
statistic: observed min–max range, not mean, median, quantile interval, or confidence interval
missing_policy: Only shared successful records with positive finite full-inference timings. Failed, missing, censored and refinement-only times are not ratios.
limitations: Historical hardware, concurrency and timing boundaries differ across campaigns. Observed ratios are not hardware-normalized speedups. ConcordTree 32–1024 timings use a retained engine; 2048–4096 use engine elapsed time in fresh CLI processes, including task-internal first-use loading. DIPPER 2048–4096 and other baselines retain archived timing scopes.
